MIDDLESEX COUNTY
SHERIFF'S SALE
26000382
SUPERIOR COURT
OF NEW JERSEY
CHANCERY DIVISION
MIDDLESEX COUNTY
DOCKET NO. F00818117
NATIONSTAR MORTGAGE LLC, is the
Plaintiff, and SEAN HUEY, ET ALS.,
are Defendants, writ of execution
for the sale of mortgaged premises
dated 01/26/2026.
By virtue of the above stated Writ,
to me directed and delivered, I will
expose to sale at public vendue on
WEDNESDAY, the 6TH DAY of MAY
A.D. 2026, at the hour of one thirty
o' clock by the then prevailing
(Standard or Daylight Saving) time,
in the afternoon of the said day, at
the Heldrich Hotel, 10 Livingston
Ave, New Brunswick, N.J. 08901.
The property to be sold is located
in the TOWNSHIP of PISCATAWAY in
the County of MIDDLESEX, and the
State of New Jersey.
Commonly known as: 1414
Redwood Drive, Piscataway, New
Jersey 08854;
Tax Lot 30.02, Block 507 f/k/a Lot
30.02, Block 70.
Dimensions of the Lot are
(Approximately) 91 x 196 x 91 x 192.
Nearest Cross Street: Cedarwood Drive.
The approximate upset sum is
$964,049.85 calculated through
February 9, 2026 plus any additional advance, interest, Sheriff's
cost and commission to the date of sale.
The occupancy status of the
subject property is unknown.
The sale is subject to unpaid taxes
and assessments, tax, water and
sewer liens and other municipal
assessments. The amount due can
be obtained from the local taxing
authority. Pursuant to NJSA 46:8B-21 the sale may also be subject to
the limited lien priority of any
condominiurn/homeowner association liens which may exist. The sale
may be further subject to Restrictions, reversions, reservations, and
easements of record.
SURPLUS MONEY: if after the sale
and satisfaction of the mortgage
debt, including costs and expenses„
there rernains any surplus money,
the money will be deposited into
the Superior Court Trust Fund and
any person claiming the surplus, or
any part thereof, may file a motion
pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and
4:57-2 stating the nature and
extent of that person's claim and
asking for an order directing
payment of the surplus money. The
Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount of the
upset to be satisfied by said sale is
the sum of FIVE HUNDRED NINETY
ONE THOUSAND ONE HUNDRED
TWENTY NINE DOLLARS AND SIXTY
SEVEN CENTS ($591,129.67) dollars
more or less, plus interest together
with the costs of this sale. THE
UPSET AMOUNT MAY BE SUBJECT
TO FURTHER ORDERS OF ADDITIONAL SUMS.
The subscriber reserves the right to
adjourn said sale from time to time
subject only to such limitations or
restrictions upon the exercise of
such power as may be specially
provided by law or rules of the
Court, Sold subject to conditions of sale.
Successful bidder must pay 20% of
bid in certified check or official
bank check at close of sale and the
balance in two weeks.
Mildred S. Scott, Sheriff
Attorney:
LOGS LEGAL GROUP LLP
14000 COMMERCE PARKWAY, SUITE B
MOUNT LAUREL, NJ 08054
Dated: 4/7, 4/14, 4/21, 4/28/2026
